sentences.text:
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

3. By way of the present petition, the petitioner seeks setting quashing of FIR bearing No. 411/2025 registered at Police Station Adarsh Nagar, District North, Delhi, for offences the punishable under Sections 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC').
4. Issue notice.
